# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

A single-route SSR React app built on TanStack Start file-based routing. The page is a flat set of presentational section components layered on shadcn/ui primitives, with no backend layer.

### Directory layout

```
.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml  # CI: curl POST to Coolify deploy API
public/                               # favicon.ico, favicon.png, apple-touch-icon.png
scripts/download-assets.mjs           # fetches binaries for src/assets/*.asset.json stubs
src/
  assets/                             # brand + portfolio JPG/PNG, plus Lovable *.asset.json stubs
  components/
    landing/                          # page sections: chrome, hero, sections, interactive, portfolio, primitives
    ui/                               # 46 shadcn/ui (new-york) primitives over Radix
  hooks/use-mobile.tsx
  lib/                                # utils.ts (cn), error-capture.ts, error-page.ts, lovable-error-reporting.ts
  routes/
    __root.tsx                        # HTML shell, head/meta, fonts, 404 + error boundary
    index.tsx                         # "/" landing page composition
  routeTree.gen.ts                    # generated by router plugin; do not edit
  router.tsx                          # getRouter(): routeTree + QueryClient context
  server.ts                           # SSR entry wrapper (tanstackStart.server.entry = "server")
  start.ts                            # createStart + errorMiddleware
  styles.css                          # Tailwind 4 theme
vite.config.ts                        # @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config defineConfig
Dockerfile                            # node:22-alpine multi-stage, EXPOSE 3000
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|---|---|---|
| Server entry (`src/server.ts`, `src/start.ts`) | Lazy-loading the server entry; turning thrown errors and h3-swallowed 500s into an HTML error page | Routing, rendering, business logic |
| Router (`src/router.tsx`, `src/routes/`) | Route tree, head/meta, HTML shell, 404, error boundary, `QueryClientProvider` | Section content |
| Landing components (`src/components/landing/`) | Copy, content arrays, layout, contact form validation | Data fetching, persistence |
| UI primitives (`src/components/ui/`) | Accessible Radix-based widgets (accordion, select, input, button, sonner) | Brand copy |
| Lib (`src/lib/`) | `cn` class merge, error capture/page/reporting | UI rendering |
| Scripts (`scripts/`) | Downloading asset binaries at dev time | Runtime behavior |

### External integration points

| System | Client/config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Coolify | `.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml` | `POST https://aguiardev.online/api/v1/deploy?uuid=…&force=false`, header `Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_API_TOKEN` |
| Lovable error events | `src/lib/lovable-error-reporting.ts` | `window.__lovableEvents?.captureException`, mechanism `react_error_boundary` |
| Lovable preview host | `scripts/download-assets.mjs` | `https://id-preview--${project_id}.lovable.app${url}` |
| Google Fonts | `src/routes/__root.tsx` links | Playfair Display 400–700, Inter 300–700 |

### Macro flow: SSR request and error handling

```
GET /  ──►  src/server.ts fetch()
              │  import("@tanstack/react-start/server-entry") (memoized)
              ▼
           start.ts errorMiddleware ──throw w/o statusCode──► 500 renderErrorPage()
              │
              ▼
           router.tsx getRouter() ──► __root.tsx RootShell ──► index.tsx Index
              │
              ▼
           Response ──► normalizeCatastrophicSsrResponse()
              │  status>=500 && JSON {"unhandled":true,"message":"HTTPError"}?
              ├── yes ──► console.error(consumeLastCapturedError()) ──► 500 HTML error page
              └── no  ──► response as-is
```

- `src/lib/error-capture.ts` records the last `error` / `unhandledrejection` on `globalThis` and keeps it for `TTL_MS = 5_000`.
